assets.name: Ashlar Wall
assets.description: 4 m bays with independently bonded faces over a mortar core. Origin at the base center.

evidence.art: Independent face bonds and recessed mortar now read more convincingly. Long copings and repetitive bay ends need refinement.
evidence.godot: Imported in the refinement 02 showcase on Hollowmark Godot 4.6.3. Isolated GLB also passed.

assets.name: Vaulted Gateway
assets.description: 2.68 m clear opening. Full-depth voussoirs with cut-to-curve spandrel courses. Origin at threshold center.

evidence.art: Cut spandrels, deeper vault and six clear opening rays. Stepped shoulders still show at the wing-wall joins.
evidence.godot: Imported in the refinement 02 showcase on Hollowmark Godot 4.6.3. Isolated GLB also passed.

assets.name: Limestone Stair
assets.description: 3.6 m-wide route. Nine 0.18 m risers and 0.34 m treads. Origin at first riser.

evidence.art: Nine treads passed the engine probes. Side support is coursed; the upper cap-to-landing transition remains abrupt.
evidence.godot: Imported in the refinement 02 showcase on Hollowmark Godot 4.6.3. Isolated GLB also passed.

assets.name: Faulted Limestone Escarpment
assets.description: Continuous sedimentary bench with dipping strata, eroded joints and a foundation shelf. Local Z=0 at the foot.

evidence.art: Single connected manifold formation with dipping beds. The exposed silhouette and wall contacts still look angular.
evidence.godot: Imported in the refinement 02 showcase on Hollowmark Godot 4.6.3. Isolated GLB also passed.

assets.name: Honed Limestone
assets.description: Image-backed pale cut-stone finish. 1.35 m UV repeat for architectural modules.

evidence.art: Neutral and 7-degree grazing review at a 1.35 m repeat. Improved mineral grain; the brightest walls still lack reference depth.
evidence.godot: Imported in the refinement 02 showcase on Hollowmark Godot 4.6.3.

assets.name: Irregular Stone Court
assets.description: Continuous paved formation with staggered sett courses. Origin at center of walking plane.

evidence.art: Supported staggered slabs. The front platform edge remains square-cut.
evidence.godot: Imported in the refinement 02 showcase on Hollowmark Godot 4.6.3.
